race.description: Club North Haven Camden Haven Cup Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: SMOKEY SAINT (1) finished third two runs back at Grafton then improved last time out to score by a long neck over 2018m at Taree. Ideally placed and is sure to play a pivotal role. FARRAIGE (2) has been well below his best in his last two but he's yet to miss the placings from four starts at this track. Backs up quickly and draws low. Can turn things around. ENZONI (9) was much better last start when only beaten 1.75 lengths into sixth over 1400m contest at Taree eight days ago. In the mix if he can build off that. BIANCO NERO (7) turned in a nice effort to score two runs ago when leading pillar-to-post but was not as effective last time. Is mixing her form but rates among the main chances on her best figures. SEETHING CHUCK (5) doesn't win out of turn but boasts peaks that can measure up, though he will need some luck from out there.
